newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea 3-yr bond yields close flat, buying active.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea 3-yr bond yields close flat, buying active.

text.p: Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds closed unchanged on Wednesday despite heavy new issues, dealers said.
New issues were estimated at 168 billion won.
They said institutional investors actively bought the three-year bonds for bargain hunting on the belief that the yields had risen enough.
Dealers said the government had requested institutions to increase buying to cap the rise of the benchmark bond yields.
Government officials were not available for comment.
But yields on three-month certificates of deposit and the overnight call rate further increased as the short-term cash liquidity remained tight.
Some dealers attributed the tight liquidity situation to the usually conservative attitude of banks ahead of the end of the first half of a year.
